notes.title: What is next for BRYGUYSTUDIOS
notes.content: Everyone, thank you for playing my games. For those wondering, the next project in production is a return to the classics. Around the size of MR 333 and will be bringing another level of terror. I hope everyone is ready.

notes.title: Finger Trees Releasing Soon
notes.content:
Finger Trees, the fifth project of BRYGUYSTUDIOS will be releasing this month, very soon. After it is released further updates for the project are planned to continue to expand what has been created so far. I hope everyone enjoys the story and the project. More experiences are planned in the future. This game has come a long way. Please feel free to find BRYGUYSTUDIOS on YouTube as I have begun releasing small videos about the games: https://www.youtube.com/@bryguystudios

notes.title: BloodPit: Skelton II releasing tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40392442/d11b2611d100a865c1422416fd3abdf51a971a0b.png[/img]Fight through the endless waves in the blood pits. Beneath the surface 'Skelton' zones. They use the magnets to pull travelers out of space-time travel. They want the human genes. They are relentless and have given up on the formal lives they once lived. They are merged between AI and people. They want abandonment of all things human, right and just. The travelers are locked away in the pits and the pits never end. You saw the surface fights in the uninhabitable 'Skelton' zones where no human can go, now you must fight again. Each floor is different. Each traveler is hidden. Each disgusting hostile can bleed. 

How many can you save? How may can you Kill?

notes.title: New MR 333 world added- TEST VERSION
notes.content: New content release for MR 333. Can be accessed by main menu screen. Find the keys to end the ritual. When the Fallen ones merge with the men through ritual only the abomination of MR 333 can be created. Vile and disturbed. The fallen ones and the men performing the ritual wish to create the monster. Stop the ritual. Find the keys and enter the pocket dimensions where the keys can be used to shut the machine down.
